    • Method Detail

      • marshall

        public void marshall(T from,
                     ResultSet results)
              throws SQLException,
                     EoDException
        Description copied from class: DataObjectBinding
        Marshall a specified object into a ResultSet. This method should only be used if a call to DataObjectBinding.isUpdateCapable() returns true. This method will attempt to place the fields of the given object into the specified ResultSet. The ResultSet given here should be in the same format as the one given to DataObjectBinding.unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet), failure to do so can result in an EoDException.
        Specified by:
        marshall in class DataObjectBinding<T>
        Parameters:
        from - the object to marshall
        results - the ResultSet who's columns are to be set
        Throws:
        SQLException - if an database error occures
        EoDException - if a marshalling error occures

      • unmarshall

        public void unmarshall(ResultSet row,
                       T into)
                throws SQLException,
                       EoDException
        Description copied from class: DataObjectBinding

        Unmarshall a ResultSet into a specified object. This method is used for any rubberstamping wrapper object. If the wrapper object is not rubberstamping, this method will not be invoked. Non-rubberstamping wrappers should make use of the DataObjectBinding.unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet) method instead of this one.

        This method should make no effort to navigate the given ResultSet. The cursor of the ResultSet will be at the row to be unmarshalled and will be nagivated by the wrapper object if needed.

        If rubberstamping is not supported by this DataObjectBinding, this method may throw an UnsupportedOperationException.

        Specified by:
        unmarshall in class DataObjectBinding<T>
        Parameters:
        row - the ResultSet to unmarshall from
        into - the mutable object to unmarshall into
        Throws:
        SQLException - if a database error occures
        EoDException - if an unmarshalling error occures
